Good questions

What photos work best?

A clear, well-lit photo of the whole room works best — stand back, get the full space in frame, and daylight helps. One room per photo keeps the redesign true to your layout.

How many redesigns do I get?

Unlimited, for subscribers. Redesign every room in the house, then try the same room in all six styles if you like — there's no cap while your subscription is active.

How do my results arrive?

By email, to the address you sent your photo from — your redesigned room image plus a shareable before/after card, typically within 24–48 hours.

How do I cancel?

Anytime, via Stripe — your subscription runs to the end of the paid period and then simply stops. No emails to send, no hoops to jump through.
